info.name: Box Authorize Authorization Domain Restrictions (User Exemptions) API
Box List users exempt from collaboration domain restrictions

params.name: marker
params.description:
Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is
used when paginating using marker-based pagination.

This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

items.docs:
Returns a list of users who have been exempt from the collaboration
domain restrictions.

info.name: Box Create user exemption from collaboration domain restrictions

items.docs:
Exempts a user from the restrictions set out by the allowed list of domains
for collaborations.

params.name: collaboration_whitelist_exempt_target_id
